shared_elements: frontal head with schematic facial features
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic beings in low relief with schematic faces and arm gestures, and both include curved/ring-like motifs, but these are the most generic possible correspondences. A shows a narrative frieze of multiple small active figures in a horizontal band, striding and raising arms in relation to one another, while B is a single monumental frontal statue-figure whose body carries isolated symbolic devices (discs, curved bands, paired appendages on the head), with no interaction between figures and no banded narrative arrangement.
